core.changelog:
- ✨ PPRuntimeStats.get_effective_stat() accepts exclude_source_prefix for filtered max computation
- ✨ PPNPCEntity built-in loot_table property + get_loot_table()/has_loot_table() API
- ✨ PPRecipeUtils.find_matching_recipe(inventory, type) convenience method
- 🔧 Fixed PPRuntimeStats._init() else branch dropping default stats
- 🔧 Fixed migration of corrupted 'undefined' extension properties on existing projects

premium.changelog:
- 🔧 Fix: new autoloads (PPSkillTreeUtils) now register on UPDATE, not only on a fresh enable - resolves 'PPSkillTreeUtils not declared' parse errors after updating
- 🎁 Skill Tree Editor: author Talents (passive perk trees) & Abilities (active skills) with a perk graph, Effect Types, conditions, validation, balance view and an allocation simulator
- 🎁 NPC Skills: give NPCs talents/abilities via a static loadout (per-perk ranks) + optional dynamic leveling
- 🎁 In-editor Documentation tab (browse the online docs without leaving Godot)
